chk_problem.poster_evidence: Edge video object detection has matured into a production technology. Dashcams, traffic-monitoring nodes, autonomous vehicles, and security cameras now routinely run convolutional or transformer-based detectors on dedicated edge systems, such as the NVIDIA Jetson family. The dominant cost in these pipelines is the per-frame forward pass through the detector.

chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: ALBIREO wraps an off-the-shelf object detector with three mechanisms: i) a forward-looking uncertainty trigger that gates detector invocation using per-object Kalman covariance growth, ii) a detector-flicker rescue mechanism that keeps confirmed object states alive when the detector briefly misses them, and iii) a lightweight empty-scene screen that avoids full detector calls on objectless frames. These mechanisms require no detector modifications or detector retraining.
chk_method.reason: The poster correctly describes the method as a detector-agnostic, codec-free adaptive inference framework using Kalman filter uncertainty, detector-flicker rescue, and empty-scene screening to skip redundant detector calls.
